taglines: Three prides hold the valley. There is room for a fourth.
Alone, you are prey. Together, you are a legend.
Long teeth. Long winters. Longer memories.
Every pride began with one cat who refused to die.
The herds move. The snow comes. The pride endures.
Your blood will outlive your name.
Before the stars had names, the sabretooths sang to them.
Hunt well. Choose well. Your cubs will remember both.

storytellerModes.name: Online Storyteller
storytellerModes.description: The richest stories. Every event is written fresh for your pride as you play. Needs an internet connection.

storytellerModes.name: Local Storyteller
storytellerModes.description: Stories are written by an AI model running on your own computer. Works offline, but needs a capable PC and may be slower.

storytellerModes.name: Classic Storyteller
storytellerModes.description: Uses a hand-written library of events. No AI and no internet needed. Fast and dependable, with less variety.

difficulties.name: Permadeath
difficulties.description: When your cat dies, the story ends. One life, one legend.

difficulties.name: Play On as Heir
difficulties.description: When your cat dies, you continue as your closest kin in the pride. If no heir is left, your legacy ends.

difficulties.name: Sandbox
difficulties.description: A gentler world with no game over. Explore, experiment, and tell the story you want at your own pace.

sandboxPanel.title: Sandbox Options
sandboxPanel.note: These choices are locked once the run begins. Sandbox runs stay Sandbox runs.

options.name: Hunger and Thirst
options.description: How quickly your cats grow hungry, thirsty, and tired.
descriptions: Your cats never go hungry or thirsty. Hunt for the story, not to survive.
Needs drop slowly, leaving plenty of time between meals.
Needs drop at the usual pace of the Ice Age.

options.name: Dangers
options.description: How often predators, rivals, storms, and other threats find your pride.
descriptions: No attacks or disasters. The valley is peaceful.
Threats appear now and then, with time to recover between them.
Threats come as often as they would in the wild.

options.name: Starting Reputation
options.description: How the prides see you when you first arrive.
descriptions: The prides distrust you. Mates and allies come hard.
The prides don't know you yet.
Your name is known and welcome.

options.name: Free Cat Customization
options.description: Unlock every look and personality option for your cat.
descriptions: All traits unlocked, including rare ones.
Common traits only, as in a normal run.

options.name: Free Perk Respec
options.description: Swap your cat's perks whenever you rest, as often as you like.
descriptions: Swap any perk whenever you rest. Nothing is set in stone.
Perk choices are permanent, as in a normal run.

playStyles.name: Story
playStyles.description: A gentler Ice Age for living the tale. Hunts succeed more often, wounds heal fast, and the pride's daily work is handled for you.

playStyles.name: Standard
playStyles.description: Survival and story in balance. You lead the pride yourself, choosing roles, patrols, and who eats first, through hard but fair seasons.

playStyles.name: Sim
playStyles.description: The Ice Age at its harshest. Prey is scarce in winter, meat spoils, wounds can fester, and every cat's hunger, den, and bloodline is yours to manage.
